scope: 只替换原V5墙面画框内地图为最新小星欢乐自拍；保留其余场景，未声称逐像素无变化。

prompts.day:
Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the source of the framed cheerful CAT SELFIE photograph on its background wall. Make an extremely localized change to IMAGE1: replace ONLY the printed world map artwork INSIDE the existing wall frame at the far RIGHT, beside the exit door, with that exact cheerful cat selfie from IMAGE2. Keep original frame size, outline, aged wood, placement, wall-plane perspective and partial cropping at image edge. Project the selfie into the original frame's oblique perspective; it is OK and necessary that much of the photo remains cropped outside the shot, just as the map was. Do NOT enlarge/recenter/relocate the frame or change camera to show more photo. Source selfie: cream/apricot Xiaoxing's happy big head with curled forelock, amber eyes, green sprout bib and glowing tilted halo, close to phone lens, furry foreleg reaching to lens; many cats behind crowd/peek happily, not formal rows. Keep exact recognizable selfie content from image2, not a different group.
Everything OUTSIDE THE MAP PRINT must remain unchanged: same camera/crop/canvas, rectangular room geometry, light/shadow/exposure, cloud sky, door opening/hinge/porthole, four-column seven-row mail cabinet and drawer count, low cabinet, desk, typewriter, lamp, green mat, stool, folded ladder, plants, flowers, rug, floor texture, botanical pictures, hooks and objects. Do not recolor or relight the room, do not add living cats, do not remove the door, do not move furniture. Keep same image aspect ratio and resolution as image1. Output just edited image1. No red marks, no annotations, no new borders.
DAY target: retain the exact daylight scene and warm exposure of image1.
